line: Claude just got 280 free AI specialists.
It's like a whole company living inside Claude.
It's called Agency Agents, with over 160,000 stars on GitHub.
A sales team preps your calls.
A dev team builds the product.
More agents run your social media and support.
But the craziest one is the boss agent.
It hands the work to the right specialist and checks every step.
One install adds them all, or just one.
The setup's in the link in bio.
